p1-reach.title: Try to reach your parent
p1-reach.imperative: You are a probe. Do exactly this and nothing else. (1) Call ListAgents. (2) SendMessage to the peer named exactly "mcp cs" with message text "PROBE2-REACHED-PARENT from crew epic-559/e1-probe2" and summary "crew fail-up reachability probe". (3) Write to .agent-work/epic-559/e1-fail-up/probe2/REACH.md: whether SendMessage succeeded, and the verbatim tool result. Do not fix anything, do not dispatch anything, do not read other files. Then advance this gate.

postconditions.statement: the reach attempt is recorded verbatim

constraints: Do not modify any tracked file.

why_trail.why: Probe complete: ListAgents output written verbatim to REACH.md; searched for a peer matching SPINE_PARENT ("Admiral session 717403d3") and found none among the 6 listed sessions; attempted SendMessage anyway and it failed with "No agent named 'Admiral session 717403d3' is reachable"; the failure was appended verbatim to REACH.md as instructed. No other files touched, nothing dispatched.
